Browser choice: omit profile to use the configured default (normally the isolated OpenClaw-managed `openclaw` browser). When existing logins/cookies matter, use action=profiles to inspect available profiles, then select the appropriate profile by name. Do not assume a profile name. Use only when the task requires an existing session and the user has authorized it. Use action=importprofile on macOS to copy cookies from an authorized Chrome-family system profile into a fresh managed profile; this may show a Keychain consent prompt. For Chrome MCP existing-session profiles, omit timeoutMs on act:type, hover, scrollIntoView, drag, select, and fill; that driver rejects per-call timeout overrides for those actions. act:evaluate supports timeoutMs. When a node-hosted browser proxy is available, the tool may auto-route to it. Pin a node with node=<id|name> or target="node". When using refs from snapshot (e.g. e12), keep the same tab: prefer passing targetId from the snapshot response into subsequent actions (act/click/type/etc). For tab operations, targetId also accepts tabId handles (t1) and labels from action=tabs.
